Article 5.1: How Payouts Work (Overview)

Warren's summary

FFN processes payouts on a same-day basis, meaning you can submit a withdrawal request the day you become eligible with no waiting for specific days or cycles. You must meet all eligibility criteria including account balance above the minimum threshold for your account size, consistency within your account's rule, a fully built buffer, $500 minimum above the buffer, and for Express MAX accounts, 5 winning days since last payout or funding. Payouts are processed via Rise, PayPal, or Wise with fees depending on method, with a minimum withdrawal of $500 and maximum of $10,000 per user per payout. You can only withdraw profit earned since your last payout, and you must not trade your account after requesting a payout until your balance has been adjusted, or your payout will be declined.

Same-Day Payouts

FFN processes payouts on a same-day basis. 'Same day' means the day you become eligible to withdraw is the day you can submit your request: there is no waiting for a specific day of the week or a monthly cycle.

Payment methods: Rise, PayPal, wise
Fees apply depending on payout method
Minimum withdrawal: $500
Maximum per user per payout: $10,000 (cumulative across all accounts)
Payout Eligibility: General Requirements (All Accounts)
Account balance must be above the Account Minimum Threshold (OG accounts; see table below)
Consistency must be within the account's rule (40% or 25%)
Buffer must be fully built (all funded accounts)
Only profit earned since your last payout can be withdrawn. For your first payout, that is the profit earned since the account was funded.
$500 minimum above the buffer must be available
For Express MAX funded: 5 winning days since last payout (or since funded)
Account Minimum Thresholds: OG Funded Accounts

For OG funded accounts, the account balance must be at or above the following thresholds to be eligible for withdrawal. Falling below this threshold is NOT a broken rule: it simply means you cannot withdraw until you recover above it.

Account Size	Minimum Threshold for Withdrawal
$25,000	$26,500
$50,000	$52,000
$100,000	$103,600
$150,000	$155,000
$250,000	$256,000

Q: When can I withdraw from my funded account?

A: You can withdraw any day you meet all eligibility criteria: buffer built, consistency within limits, $500+ above buffer, and (for Express MAX) 5 winning days accumulated.

Q: My account balance dropped below the minimum threshold. Is my account failed?

A: No. Dropping below the minimum threshold alone does not fail your account. You simply cannot withdraw until you trade your balance back above the threshold.

Q: Can I continue to trade my account before my balance is adjusted and I am waiting on my payout?

A: Do not trade your account until your account balance has been adjusted. If you trade on the account before the funds are sent, your payout will be declined.
